notes.title: v0.0.4 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue where character-specific volume controls in the settings were not working.
 Improved UI visibility on save/load screens.
 A bug that allowed you to revert your selection via the backlog has been fixed. From now on, the content before you make a selection will only be saved as normal logs.
 Fixed an issue where the game would freeze when closing a pop-up window by pressing ESC.
 Removed the shading on the selection buttons and fixed them to initialize and reorder based on the mouse cursor position.
 Fixed some dialogue and dubbing errors in Raul’s scenario.
 System UI terminology has been revised for each supported language.
 Some improvements to translations in Russian, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Chinese, Vietnamese, Thai, and Indonesian. For localization, we will continue to make improvements through updates. Please give us your feedback!
 Some sound effects have been added to Raul's and Tyrineon's scenario.

notes.title: v0.0.3 Patch Notes
notes.notes: Fixed an issue where Tyrineon's character voice was out of sync.
